title: SIAT 4.0 Week Ends With the Night Nobody Wanted to End
headline: Games, Dancing and Ghanaian Indigenous Games Fill the DIAT Compound
body: Friday 31 July 2026. The SIAT 4.0 Week closing night pulled students from across KNUST into the DIAT compound for Oware, Ludo, Ampe, Spar and more — under the lights, hours before exam season. Digitally archived as part of DIAT’s 50th Anniversary celebrations.

title: DIAT Exhibit at the E-Learning International Conference
headline: DIAT Holds a Stunning Exhibition at the E-Learning International Conference
body: The Great Hall was full. Hundreds of delegates from across the world had gathered for the fourth annual E-Learning Week and International Conference 2026 at KNUST. In the middle of it all, one stand carried a different kind of energy. DIAT’s Visibility Exhibition and Sales brought hand-carved stools, bamboo jewellery, leather goods, wall frames, and sandals into a conversation about AI and digital archiving — and the Head of Department, Dr. Asubonteng Kwabena, was there to tell every visitor exactly why these objects matter.

title: DIAT Explained
headline: What Exactly is DIAT? Watch Our Four-Minute Introduction
body: Six craft disciplines. One design spine. A 50-year legacy. In under four minutes, this short film takes you inside the Department of Indigenous Art and Technology at KNUST — the only university department in Ghana dedicated entirely to indigenous craft as living, professionally relevant practice.

title: TGIF in Colour: A Leather Printing Showcase
headline: Second-Years Showcase a Tapestry of Leather Printing Methods
body: DIAT's compound turned into a gallery of colour on 26 June 2026 as second-year Leather Technology students hung out their finished end-of-semester work — screen printing, embossing, heat transfer, and more, drawing visitors from across campus.

title: DIAT Tops Group A at CABE's 75th Anniversary Quiz
headline: DIAT Wins Group A of CABE's Inter-Departmental Quiz
body: DIAT's quiz team beat Land Economy (38.5) and Publishing Studies (20.5) with a winning score of 41 in Group A of the CABE 75th Anniversary Inter-Departmental Quiz Competition, held 23 June 2026 at the New CABE Building.

title: When Leather Met Colour: A Sankofa Exchange at DIAT, KNUST
headline: Second Visit, Same Spirit: Sacramento State Returns to DIAT
body: Under the spirit of Sankofa — the Ghanaian symbol that teaches it is no fault to return to the past and carry forward what is valuable — students from Sacramento State University joined DIAT's Leather Technology section at KNUST for a second year running. Tie-dye, marbling, a face pressed straight out of carved wood — we filmed the whole thing.
